title: R3: anchored decisions replay
outcome: --decisions RUN replays only operator-signed Controls from a source that passes anchored verify --head
acceptance: Source without a matching anchor, or repro, is refused; config.decisions_from = source anchor hash
Only ks.operator-signed Controls are replayed; an approval whose plan_hash differs gives hold/stale_plan
summary: Fix: load_decisions only extracts rows with seq <= anchor.seq (unwitnessed tail never replayed); test_unwitnessed_tail_is_not_replayed. Switched to replay_mismatch (B3-47): replay and decisions_from mismatches now report replay_mismatch (TAMPER); tests updated.
review:
[kabir · changes] BLOCKER (reproduced): load_decisions replays Controls from the unwitnessed tail. If a source has records after the last witness checkpoint, verify --head passes (anchored=True, last_witnessed_seq=2), but _extract reads the whole record.jsonl. A seq-3 ks.operator Control past anchor.seq was returned. That breaks 'tamper-evident up to the last witnessed head'. Fix: only use rows with seq <= anchor.seq (pass the anchor into _extract) and add a test: control at seq anchor.seq+1 is not replayed. OK: a different run's anchor fails on config_hash (binds run_id); an older head of the same run gives head_mismatch; agent/monitor/non-c-0 Controls are filtered and verify enforces system_tool_signers. RULING on reason: hash_mismatch/TAMPER is wrong for a divergent replay. The records are intact, and the jury would read it as tampering. A dedicated reason 'replay_mismatch' (own exit code, not TAMPER) goes to maya as a minor contracts bump. The decisions_from mismatch also reuses config_mismatch (an anchor-hash meaning); move it to the same new reason. WIRING: the library-level acceptance is met once the tail is fixed. End-to-end '--decisions RUN replays' is not, so it needs a linked follow-up. Add an acceptance line to B3-30 (approval-bound apply, where approval replay matters): 'ks run --decisions SRC sets config.decisions_from=anchor_hash and replays controls at source ticks; verify_replay ok', and move decisions into SERVED there.

[kabir · done] Blocker fixed. My tail PoC now passes: load_decisions reads only seq <= anchor.seq, and test_unwitnessed_tail_is_not_replayed covers it. The replay_mismatch switch has landed: verify_replay uses replay_mismatch for control/approval divergence and for decisions_from (config_mismatch is no longer used there). Tests assert the reason. Exit code follows VERIFY_REASONS, so it moves automatically if B3-47's mapping changes (see my B3-47 review). Still owed, as already agreed: an end-to-end 'ks run --decisions SRC' acceptance line on B3-30.
